audit.why: TRICKY at 7/10, carry threat 7.5/10, against a 40.75% Emerald+ win rate over the mirror sample of 319 games. Left alone so it stays the inverse of the Gwen-side page.

MIRROR REUSE: Mel chart is already Mel/Skill/Gwen/Mel/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen in both layers, which is exactly the chart audits/top/gwen__mel.json proposes for the Gwen side. No edit needed. NOTE the packet is the odd one out here — tools/audit-run/packets/mel.json and packets/gwen.json both list Skill/Gwen/Mel/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen, which the mirror agent judged to be two stages mis-slotted. I followed the mirror, not the packet, so the two directions agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[2] and the early paragraph both tell you to Rebuttal her Q: "eat and reflect her thrown Q snips" and "Rebuttal can wall and reflect it". Snip Snip is not a projectile.
audit.why: Riot text: "Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times", range 450. The only projectile in her kit is Needlework (R), range 1200 — it carries the projectile flag and nothing else does. So Rebuttal blocks Snip Snip damage but reflects nothing before level 6, and the one cast worth saving it for is Needlework. The mirror flagged the Needlework reflection as missing from its side too.
audit.corrected: Snip Snip is a cone; Needlework is the projectile Rebuttal sends back.

audit.whatIsWrong: "Her E charges" / "no E charges yet" / "once her E charges stack" appears in four places. Skip ’n Slash is not a charge ability.
audit.why: Riot text: "Gwen dashes a short distance then gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage On-Hit for a few seconds. If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability’s cooldown is partially refunded." One dash on 13/12.5/12/11.5/11 with a partial refund on hit. Telling the player to count charges points them at a resource that does not exist; what actually matters is that trading with her refunds the dash and lets her re-engage.
audit.corrected: One dash, 13s at rank 1, cooldown partially refunded whenever she connects.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr was the boilerplate string shared verbatim with the Camille and Fiora pages — "His dash goes through your reflect" — with a male pronoun for a female champion. All seven full-layer phase whys are the same cross-matchup template and also say he/his.
audit.why: The identical tldr appears in mel.full.js for camille, fiora and gwen, so it was never written for this matchup. Three phase whys were also Mel-positive while sitting under a side of Gwen.
audit.corrected: Matchup-specific tldr and phase whys naming Hallowed Mist, Snip Snip, Skip ’n Slash and Needlework with cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appears anywhere on the page, including for Hallowed Mist, which the focus field names as the thing to track.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist 22/21/20/19/18, Snip Snip 6.5/5.75/5/4.25/3.5, Skip ’n Slash 13/12.5/12/11.5/11, Needlework 120/100/80, Rebuttal 38/35/33/29/26. "Track Hallowed Mist" with 22s attached is a different instruction from "track Hallowed Mist". The mirror added the same numbers on the Gwen side.
audit.corrected: Hallowed Mist 22s at rank 1 added to the phase why and whys[3]; Snip Snip 6.5s and Rebuttal 38s added where they change the advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: A Thousand Cuts heals Gwen off every proc and Grievous Wounds is never mentioned.
audit.why: _missing/mel.json flags needs-antiheal. Riot text: her attacks deal bonus magic damage based on target health and "She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect." Against a chip-and-stack champion that passive sustain is what undoes a lane of Overwhelm, and the early paragraph even concedes "she trades it all back with her passive" without naming the counter.
audit.corrected: Buy Grievous Wounds early; added to the late paragraph.

edits.before: His dash goes through your reflect — snare the landing spot and save W for the burst, not the engage.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist makes her untargetable from outside — hold Rebuttal for Needlework, her one projectile.

edits.before: Q volleys win every level-1 range war — fan them across his last-hit positions and stack Overwhelm early.
edits.after: Q volleys win the level-1 range war — fan them across her last-hit spots and stack Overwhelm early.

edits.before: W Rebuttal online — the reflect turns his poke into your poke. Hold it for his real spell, not for chip.
edits.after: Rebuttal online, but her only projectile is Needlework at 6. Until then it is a 38s immunity button.

edits.before: Full kit: E snare into full Q volleys is your core chunk. Snare through the wave where he must stand to farm.
edits.after: Snip Snip on 6.5s and Skip ’n Slash close your range. Snare her step-up, then give ground before she lands.

edits.before: Stack Overwhelm with every hit — once he's marked deep, your execute math starts working. Track Hallowed Mist before stepping up.
edits.after: Stack Overwhelm with every hit — once she is marked deep your execute math works. Track Hallowed Mist (22s) before stepping up.

edits.before: Golden Eclipse online — anyone you've stacked is now walking around with a countdown. Chip, stack, execute.
edits.after: Golden Eclipse is global, but Hallowed Mist (22s) and her R chase answer it. Chip, stack, wait the mist out.

edits.before: Two items in, you're an execute platform: stack in teamfights and R the moment the bar fills. Watch your flanks.
edits.after: Two items in she duels you flat: stack the whole team in fights and never let Skip ’n Slash reach you alone.

edits.before: Force short trades before level 4 while she is a melee with no W mist and no E charges to dodge your poke
edits.after: Force short trades before level 4 while she is a melee with no Hallowed Mist and no Skip ’n Slash refund

edits.before: Use Rebuttal to eat and reflect her thrown Q snips, then disengage with its move speed before she closes the gap
edits.after: Save Rebuttal for Needlework — it is her only projectile, so it is the one cast you can send back at her

edits.before: Stack passive thousand-cut procs and farm safely to the 2-item window where she duels you flat
edits.after: Heal off A Thousand Cuts procs and farm safely to the 2-item window where she duels you flat

edits.before: Both of you are mediocre at level 1 with one ability up: you have Q poke and a ranged auto, she has no E charges yet, so it is a true wash.
edits.after: Both of you are mediocre at level 1 with one ability up: you have Q poke and a ranged auto, she has no Skip ’n Slash yet, so it is a wash.

edits.before: Level 2 she usually has Q true damage plus an E charge to dash in and trade through your single bolt before you have your root.
edits.after: Level 2 she usually has Snip Snip true damage plus Skip ’n Slash to dash in and trade through your single bolt before you have your root.

edits.before: By levels 4-5 her E charges and W Hallowed Mist let her bait your root, dash in and sit untargetable where your Q and stacks whiff.
edits.after: By levels 4-5 Skip ’n Slash and Hallowed Mist (22s) let her bait your root, dash in and sit untargetable where your Q and stacks whiff.

edits.before: Gwen is a melee with no escape until her E charges come online, so levels 1-3 are your window. Hold Solar Snare for the exact moment she walks up to last-hit, root her, and chain Q bolts plus an empowered auto to stack Overwhelm. Don't dump everything chasing into mist range. Her Q true-damage snip is her only ranged poke pre-6, and Rebuttal can wall and reflect it if you read it. The catch: she trades it all back with her passive, so this is a genuine coin-flip, not a free lane.
edits.after: Gwen is a melee with no dash until Skip ’n Slash comes online, so levels 1-3 are your window. Hold Solar Snare for the exact moment she walks up to last-hit, root her, and chain Q bolts plus an empowered auto to stack Overwhelm. Don’t dump everything chasing into mist range. Snip Snip is a 450-range cone, not a missile, so Rebuttal blocks its damage but has nothing to reflect until Needlework at 6. She trades it all back with her passive heal, so this is a coin-flip, not a free lane.

edits.before: Level 3 is your peak with Q, root and Rebuttal all online to poke, lock and negate her step-up. But once her E charges stack and W Hallowed Mist exists, the lane tilts. She baits your Solar Snare, E-dashes in, and parks in mist where your Q barrage and Overwhelm stacks simply don't register a target. At 6 your Golden Eclipse can detonate stacks from any range, but she answers with untargetability and her own R chase reset, so respect the all-in.
edits.after: Level 3 is your peak with Q, root and Rebuttal all online to poke, lock and negate her step-up. But once Skip ’n Slash refunds its own cooldown on every hit and W Hallowed Mist exists at 22s, the lane tilts. She baits your Solar Snare, dashes in, and parks in mist where your Q barrage and Overwhelm stacks find no target. At 6 Golden Eclipse detonates stacks from any range, but she answers with the mist and her R chase, so respect the all-in.

edits.before: This is Gwen's game. She is a hard scaler and you are a 550-range mage with no dash and one CC. Once she has Riftmaker and Nashor, her Q true damage chunks your squishy frame, her E closes your poke gap, and Hallowed Mist eats your entire kit on command. Your only path is to have snowballed the early window so hard her scaling never matters. If the lane went even, accept she wins the straight duel late and play for picks, peel and team detonations rather than a 1v1.
edits.after: This is Gwen’s game. She is a hard scaler and you are a 550-range mage with no dash and one CC. Once she has Riftmaker and Nashor, Snip Snip’s true damage chunks you, Skip ’n Slash closes your poke gap, and Hallowed Mist eats your kit on command. Buy Grievous Wounds early — A Thousand Cuts heals her off every proc. Your path is to snowball the early window; if lane went even, play picks and team detonations, never the 1v1.

notes: DATA-RULE DEVIATION, same as the rest of my slice: packet games is null, but gwen.json packet records 319 games and the win rates are exact complements (40.75/59.25), so I treated this as real data rather than deferring. CHART CONFLICT RESOLVED TOWARD THE MIRROR: both packets say Skill/Gwen/Mel/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen but gwen__mel.json argues two whys are mis-slotted and sets Mel/Skill/Gwen/Mel/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen, which is what Mel page already has. I changed nothing, so the two directions now agree and mirror-fix has nothing to reconcile — but the packet generator is out of step and that is the second packet defect in this champion. LEFT ALONE AS UNVERIFIABLE: whys[4] claims Hallowed Mist lets her "vanish from your stacked damage on demand", i.e. that untargetability beats Golden Eclipse, and spikes[3] says W untargets your Q barrage. Riot text says only that she can be targeted solely by enemies inside the mist; whether that stops a global Overwhelm detonation or an AoE zone is not answerable from the kit. I did not reinforce or remove those claims. The mirror left the same question open from its side.
